tasks.title: A port mask: MSP and a second function
tasks.statement: A port has MSP enabled plus one more function whose bit in the `serialPortFunction_e` table is **{b}**. What function mask will the `serial` line of this port show?
tasks.solution: A port mask is the sum of the bits of its functions. MSP = 1, so the mask = 1 + the bit of the second function: for example, 1 + 131072 = 131073 for an HD system (MSP + VTX), 1 + 128 = 129 for MSP with Blackbox.

tasks.title: How many ports with MSP
tasks.statement: The port masks in `diff all` are: VCP — 1, UART1 — **{a}**, UART2 — **{b}**, UART3 — **{c}**, UART4 — **{d}**. How many ports with MSP will the configuration check count (no more than three are allowed)?
tasks.solution: MSP is bit 1, that is, the lowest bit of the mask: every odd mask has it (1, 33, 129, 513, 131073). USB VCP counts on a par with the UARTs, and MSP is mandatory on it. If the result is more than three, the port configuration is invalid and is reset to defaults at boot.
